options.name: Now
options.line: The words on the left at every stop, the names of the stops along a bar at the bottom.

options.name: Callout
options.line: The words stand beside the part with a line to it. The progress is a ruler down the guitar's real length.

options.name: Chapter
options.line: A huge glowing word for the part, the words in a new corner each stop, the guitar's outline as the progress.

options.name: Viewfinder
options.line: Brackets close on the part like a camera focusing. The progress is a focus scale sliding under a mark.
